title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Internet access must be used for business purposes only and provided only as needed to perform users’ jobs.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Users may send and receive Internet e-mail messages, with or without document attachments, as needed.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Users may use HTTP browser tools and World Wide Web services as necessary for business purposes; Internet-originated access is limited to dedicated company public web servers.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Users may send and receive data or files through FTP as necessary for business purposes.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: User strong authentication is required for Internet-initiated Telnet contacts into the company.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Internet services other than those authorized by management are considered unauthorized and must not be allowed.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: As part of an Internet access request, an employee must read the Internet Usage Policy and associated Internet/Intranet Security Policy and sign statements confirming understanding of and agreement to comply with both policies.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: A signed policy acknowledgment form is required before Internet access may be granted.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: The user or the user’s manager must request Internet access by submitting an IT Access Request form to the IT department with a signed Internet Usage Coverage Acknowledgment Form.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Internet access must be discontinued upon employee termination, contract completion, end of a non-employee’s service, or disciplinary action arising from a policy violation.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: When a user’s job function changes or the user transfers, the original access code must be discontinued and may be reissued only if necessary and after approval of a new access request.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: User IDs that have been inactive for 30 days must be revoked.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Management must reevaluate user privileges annually.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Systems administrators must promptly revoke privileges that management identifies as no longer needed by users.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Internet access may be approved and provided only when reasonable business needs are identified.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Internet services must be granted based on an employee’s current job responsibilities.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: An employee who moves to another business unit or changes job functions must submit a new Internet access request within five days.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Company departments must periodically review users’ Internet access requirements to ensure that a continuing need exists.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Users must use Internet access solely to support business activities necessary to carry out their job functions.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Users must follow corporate resource-usage principles and exercise good judgment when using the Internet.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Internet access may be used for communications between employees and non-employees for business purposes.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: IT technical support may use Internet access to download software upgrades and patches.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Internet access may be used to review potential vendors’ websites for product information.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Internet access may be used to reference regulatory or technical information.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Internet access may be used for research supporting job functions.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Users must obtain approval from both their manager and the IT department before using company computer resources to access the Internet for personal purposes.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: The company network must create an audit log of service requests and inbound and outbound addresses, and the log must be reviewed periodically.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Users must not acquire, store, or disseminate illegal or pornographic data or data that negatively depicts race, sex, or creed.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Users must not conduct a business enterprise using company Internet resources.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Users must not engage in political activity using company Internet resources.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Users must not engage in any form of intelligence collection from company facilities.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Users must not engage in fraudulent activities.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Users must not knowingly disseminate false or otherwise libelous materials.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Users must not access company information outside the scope of their work, including customer account information or personnel files without authorization or information not needed to perform their jobs.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Users must not misuse, alter, or disclose customer or personnel information without proper authorization, including making unauthorized personnel-file changes or sharing electronic customer or personnel data with unauthorized persons.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Users must not deliberately point or hyperlink company websites to sites whose content is inconsistent with or violates company aims or policies.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Users must not engage in conduct that constitutes or encourages a criminal offense, creates civil liability, or violates local, state, national, or international laws or regulations, including U.S. export-control laws and regulations.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Users must not use, transmit, duplicate, or voluntarily receive material that infringes any person’s or organization’s copyrights, trademarks, trade secrets, or patent rights; Internet materials must be presumed copyrighted or patented unless a specific notice states otherwise.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Users must not transmit proprietary, confidential, or otherwise sensitive information without proper controls.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Users must not create, post, transmit, or voluntarily receive unlawful, offensive, libelous, threatening, or harassing material, including comments based on race, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or political beliefs.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Users must not engage in any form of gambling.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Unless specifically authorized, users must not download shareware programs or files without advance authorization from both the IT department and the user’s manager.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Unless specifically authorized, users must not order items or services over the Internet.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Unless specifically authorized, users must not play games.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Unless specifically authorized, users must not forward chain letters.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Unless specifically authorized, users must not participate in online contests or promotions.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Unless specifically authorized, users must not accept promotional gifts.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Users must make reasonable efforts to use shared company and Internet bandwidth in ways that do not negatively affect other employees.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Departments may establish bandwidth-use and resource-allocation guidelines and may prohibit downloading particular file types.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: When at work or using company computing or networking resources, users must not copy software in a manner inconsistent with the vendor’s license agreement.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Questions about whether copying is lawful must be referred to the IT department for review or to the Legal department for a ruling before copying occurs.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Materials available over the Internet may be reproduced only with the written permission of the author or document owner.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Unless copyright-owner permission is first obtained, users must not copy material from magazines, journals, newsletters, other publications, or online documents unless the copying is reasonable and customary fair use consistent with international copyright laws.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: All publicly writable directories on Internet-connected computers must be reviewed and cleared each evening to prevent anonymous exchange of information inconsistent with company business, including pirated information, passwords, credit card numbers, and pornography.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Internet activities must be subject to periodic monitoring, and management may examine e-mail, personal file directories, web access, and other information stored on company computers at any time and without notice to ensure policy compliance and support information-system management.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Users must recognize that clear-text e-mail is not confidential and may be forwarded, intercepted, printed, stored, or altered, and that deleting it from a workstation does not eliminate it from systems through which it was transmitted.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: When employees use company resources and state an affiliation with the company, they must clearly indicate that the opinions expressed are their own and not necessarily those of the company.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Users must not place company materials, including internal memos, press releases, product or usage information, or documentation, on mailing lists, public newsgroups, or similar services.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Posting company materials requires approval from the employee’s manager and the public relations department and must be performed by an authorized individual.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Individuals or business units wishing to establish a World Wide Web home page or site must first develop business, implementation, and maintenance plans.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Formal authorization to establish a company web page or site must be obtained through the IT department.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: Material made available to the public through the Internet must be formally reviewed and approved before publication.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: All web material must be submitted to the Corporate Communications Directors for initial approval to continue.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: All company web pages must be owned by and remain the ultimate responsibility of the Corporate Communications Directors.

title: Internet Usage Standard
definition: All company websites must be protected from unwanted intrusion through formal security measures obtained from the IT department.
